title: Sold Out in Fifteen Minutes  (Agotado en quince minutos)

segments.t: En el animado mostrador del café, Tessa corta las tartas doradas en platos blancos tan rápido como Hannah y Owen logran llevar las bandejas hacia el patio. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
Sigamos frase por frase este alegre ajetreo en el rincón del café.
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
'¡Dos tés de menta y tres tartas de limón para la mesa cuatro bajo el árbol!'
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
'¡Sale enseguida! ¡Owen, lleva la tetera caliente a la mesa de la ventana de la esquina!'
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
'¡La mesa dos dice que esta base de almendra es la mejor repostería de la calle Linden!'
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
'¡Dile a la mesa dos que el secreto fueron mis dos aprendices de cocina el miércoles!'
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
'¿Cuántas porciones de tarta de limón quedan en la bandeja cuatro, Tessa?'
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
'¡Cuéntalas: una, dos, tres, de cuarenta porciones en quince minutos!'
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
'¡Menos mal que horneaste dos bandejas extra de rollos de canela tibios por si acaso!'
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
'¡Escuchen, la sala acaba de quedarse en silencio! ¡Alguien está dando golpecitos en un atril!'
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
'¡Nuestro vecino del número diez trajo su estuche de violín adentro de la habitación nueve!'
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
'Dejen los platos limpios por cinco minutos, ustedes dos. ¡Vengan a escuchar en la puerta!'
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
'¡Guarda esas últimas tres porciones de tarta para Evelyn, Graham y Arthur!'
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
'Fuera delantales: ¡son las seis en punto del viernes!'
Escuchemos una vez más toda la escena.
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
Treinta y siete porciones de tarta han volado en un cuarto de hora y todo el patio contiene el aliento a las seis en punto. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
